title: Read and Write FreeSurfer Neuroimaging File Formats
text: need FreeSurfer installed use package. implements readers writers following file formats: MGH/MGZ: FreeSurfer 4-dimensional brain images arbitrary data. Typically single 3D brain MRI scan time series scans, morphometry data brain surfaces. format named Massachusetts General Hospital, specs given (rather implicitely) FreeSurfer wiki. MGZ just gzipped version MGH. example file recon-output subject mri/T1.mgz (containing 3D brain volume), also surf/lh.area.fwhm15.fsaverage.mgh (containing surface data mapped standard space). format can read written. Reading writing header data also supported, transforms like ras2vox matrix can computed header, allowing proper orientation voxel data different spaces. FreeSurfer curv format: Morphometry data brain surface, one scalar per vertex. thickness area cerebral cortex mesh vertex. Two versions format exist, ASCII version binary version (one used current FreeSurfer versions). example file surf/lh.area. versions format can read written. FreeSurfer annotation file format: Contains cortical parcellation. cortical parcellation originates brain atlas contains label vertex surface assigns vertex one set atlas regions. (Put another way, parcellation splits brain surface disjunct atlas regions). file format also contains colortable, assigns color code atlas region. example file labels/lh.aparc.annot. format can read written. standard atlases come FreeSurfer Desikan-Killiany (aparc), DKT (aparc.DKTatlas40), Destrieux (aparc.a2009s). FreeSurfer surface file format: Contains brain surface mesh binary format. mesh defined list vertices (vertex given x,y,z coords) list faces (face given three vertex indices). example file surf/lh.white. format can read written. Reading writing ASCII version FreeSurfer surface format (.asc files) also supported. mesh file formats: Read write support available meshes VTK ASCII format (.vtk files), Surf-Ice format (.mz3), Wavefront object format (.obj), Object File Format (.), Brainvoyager SRF format (.srf), Stanford triangle format (.ply). Additionally, meshes can exported PLY2 format (.ply2). Meshes can imported files BYU format (.byu), GEO format (.geo) TRI format (also known ICO mesh format, .tri). FreeSurfer label file format: Contains list vertices included label. label like mask, typically used describe vertices part certain brain region. example file label/lh.cortex.label. Volume labels also supported. format can read written. FreeSurfer color lookup table (LUT) file format: Contains color lookup table ASCII format. LUT assigns names RGBA color values set structures (typically brain regions). LUT data can also extracted annotation, set labels LUT can merged annotation. example file FREESURFER_HOME/FreeSurferColorLUT.txt. format can read written. FreeSurfer weight file format: Contains one value per listed vertex. contrast curv files, weight files contain values vertices surface, subset vertices defined indices. format known weight format, paint format, simply w format. format can read written. FreeSurfer patch file format: Contains subset surface (surface patch), given vertex indices (faces ASCII version). patch vertex, also stores whether vertex part patch border. format can read written. FreeSurfer spatial transformation matrices can read LTA, register.dat, xfm files. FreeSurfer Group Descriptor (FSGD) files: please see fsbrain package FSGD read write file support. handy conducted GLM-based statistical analyses FreeSurfer want visualize results R. NIFTI v1: FreeSurfer morphometry data NIFTI v1 format (including .nii .nii.gz) files can read written NIFTI v1 support. FreeSurfer NIFTI v1 files use (non-standard) FreeSurfer NIFTI hack also supported. files created FreeSurfer tools NIFTI output requested one dimension data larger 32k entries allowed NIFTI v1 standard. affects virtually surface-based data files brain surface meshes FreeSurfer typically 100k vertices. NIFTI v2: package comes NIFTI v2 reader writer. 2nd format version supports larger data dimensions drops backwards compatibility older NIFTI-style file formats like ANALYZE. Fiber track formats (DTI, diffusion tensor imaging): read support ‘.trk’ format used Diffusion Toolkit / TrackVis ‘.tck’ ‘.tsf’ formats used MRtrix3. also provide wrappers adapter functions existing neuroimaging file format packages, load data freesurferformats data structures: NIFTI volumes (v1, single file): Reading supported based oro.nifti package. result transformed fs.volume instance, including computation transformation matrices like vox2ras NIFTI header q-form/s-form, NIFTI volumes can used just like MGH/MGZ volumes. (Note: need FreeSurfer-style transforms want read NIFTI files, use oro.nifti directly.) Alternatively, internal NIFTI1 reader can used, also supports non-standard FreeSurfer NIFTI1 files (see ). GIFTI: General reading supported based gifti xml2 packages. GIFTI versatile format can hold different kinds data, freesurferformats provides custom readers morphometry data, surface meshes, labels annotations. freesurferformats also comes GIFTI write support, including general data array writer well custom writers previously listed kinds neuroimaging data. CIFTI: Reading morphometry data CIFTI v2 files (.dscalar.nii) supported based cifti package John Muschelli. wrapper functions freesurferformats support extraction data specific brain model (surface mesh), map data appropriate vertex indices surface based CIFTI metadata.
